name: VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon, half marathon, 10K, and 5K race in Hanoi, Vietnam on October 18, 2026, organized by VPBank.
ai_summary: The VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18, 2026, in Hanoi, Vietnam, organized by VPBank. Runners can choose from four distances: full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10K, and 5K. The race starts at Hoan Kiem Lake and finishes on Tran Nhan Tong walking street. Registration is currently open at Early Bird pricing.

core_facts.venue: Start Hoan Kiem Lake, finish Tran Nhan Tong walking street

faqs.question: When is the VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The VPBank Hanoi International Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 18, 2026. The event will be held in Hanoi, Vietnam, starting at Hoan Kiem Lake and finishing on Tran Nhan Tong walking street, with registration currently open at Early Bird rates.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The race offers four distance options for participants: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10K race, and a 5K race. This range allows runners of varying experience and fitness levels to select a distance that suits them.

faqs.question: How much does registration cost?
faqs.answer: Early Bird registration pricing is currently VND 999,000 for the full marathon (42K), VND 899,000 for the half marathon (21K), VND 699,000 for the 10K, and VND 599,000 for the 5K. These prices reflect the current Early Bird registration period.
